功能演示章——这里逐站陈列引擎的玩家功能，每一站都是真机制。: Feature Showcase chapter — each stop displays one of the engine's player features, every one a real mechanism.
选一站进去体验；演毕可回枢纽，或去词汇全席继续巡览。: Pick a stop to try; when done, return to the hub or head to the Vocabulary Feast to keep touring.
已读与快进站。先正常读一遍下面的句子——推进过的会被记为已读。: Seen & Skip stop. First read the lines below normally — anything you advance past is marked as seen.
引擎把每句 say 的已读坐标存进 persistent 层，跨存档、跨会话存活: The engine stores each say line's seen coordinate in the persistent layer, surviving across saves and sessions.
打开工具栏 Skip，并在偏好里启用「仅未读停」：skip 快进已读、遇到未读停: Turn on Skip in the toolbar and enable "Stop on unseen only" in preferences: skip fast-forwards seen lines and stops at unseen ones.
这一句故意未读——开了「仅未读停」时，skip 会在这里停住等你。: This line is deliberately unseen — with "Stop on unseen only" on, skip pauses here and waits for you.
Auto 则按偏好延时自动推进，与 skip 共用节奏闸门。: Auto advances on the preference delay, sharing the same pacing gate as skip.
下面这句是 noskip 硬闸门：skip 与 auto 都不推进它，只能手动点: The next line is a noskip hard gate: neither skip nor auto advances it — you must click forward manually.
读完后离开再回来（或读档重来），已读段就能被 skip 快进——这就是跨档已读。: Leave and come back after reading (or reload a save), and the seen lines can be fast-forwarded by skip — that's cross-save seen tracking.
提示：工具栏 Auto/Skip 快捷按钮与偏好开关由宿主提供，状态实时生效。: Tip: the toolbar Auto/Skip shortcuts and preference toggles are provided by the host and take effect in real time.
音频实例多轨站。实例是作者点名的编排单元，可多轨叠加、各自独立。: Audio multi-track stop. Instances are author-named orchestration units that can layer on multiple tracks, each independent.
两轨叠加：bgm 实例 melody 与 ambient 实例 wind 同时播: Two tracks layered: bgm instance melody and ambient instance wind play at once without interfering.
把 melody 单独调到 0.8，wind 不受影响——实例音量独立。: Set melody alone to 0.8; wind is unaffected — instance volume is independent.
只暂停 wind 一轨，melody 继续——实例暂停独立。: Pause only the wind track while melody keeps going — instance pause is independent.
恢复 wind，从暂停位置续播，不从头重播。: Resume wind from where it paused, not from the start.
se 通道一次性触发：点击音与确认音，不进实例、不可暂停。: The se channel fires one-shots: a click sound and a confirm sound — no instance, not pausable.
打字音素材已备（se_type），此处一次性试听；逐字打字接线需宿主钩子，诚实缓: A typing sound asset is ready (se_type), auditioned here as a one-shot; per-character typing wiring needs a host hook and is honestly deferred.
voice 通道实例 vox（既有素材占位演示通道；真配音素材缓办）。: Voice-channel instance vox (an existing asset stands in to demo the channel; real voice-over is deferred).
停掉全部实例，声场清空。四通道与实例维度演示完毕。: Stop all instances and clear the sound field. The four-channel and instance dimensions are fully demoed.
不可回溯段站。锁定前，back/滚轮/历史按钮都可用。: No-rollback segment stop. Before locking, back / wheel-rollback / history buttons all work.
已锁定回退：此刻起 back、滚轮回退、历史按钮都被宿主禁用。: Rollback locked: from now on the host disables back, wheel-rollback, and history buttons.
这是不可回溯段——剧情关键节点，玩家无法反悔。: This is a no-rollback segment — a key story beat where the player can't take it back.
段内推进若干句，锁定持续生效；快照仍记录，只是不允许回退。: Advance a few lines within the segment; the lock stays in effect. Snapshots are still recorded, just no rollback allowed.
解锁回退：back 恢复可用。不可回溯段演示完毕。: Rollback unlocked: back works again. No-rollback segment demo complete.
小游戏与交互站：玩法系统分流进文本创作列，演示 TS 流与文本流共存可达。: Minigame & interaction stop: gameplay systems branch into text-authored columns, showing TS flow and text flow coexist and stay reachable.
先体验交互 walk：用 A/D 或方向键走到终点，成功进入文本画廊列 text: First try the walk interaction: use A/D or arrow keys to reach the goal; success enters the text gallery column text_gallery.
再体验小游戏 click3：点够 3 次，成功进入文本故事列 text_tale: Then try the click3 minigame: click 3 times; success enters the text story column text_tale (gold +10).
